title: Misting Reservoir Days-to-Empty
dataSources: Apex controller readings (`apex:reading`), Seneye measurements (`seneye:reading`), reptile thermostat events (`reptilethermostat:event`), and misting-system cycles (`mister:cycle`).
app: Aquarium and terrarium telemetry from Neptune Apex, Seneye, reptile thermostats, and misting systems sent to Splunk HEC via controller APIs, MQTT, and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=mister:cycle
| search days_to_empty=*
| stats latest(days_to_empty) as days_to_empty latest(fill_level_pct) as fill_level_pct by reservoir_name
| sort 0 - days_to_empty
description: Ranks reservoirss by misting reservoir runway.
value: Days-to-empty is the easiest way to avoid surprise dry reservoirs on busy weeks.
implementation: Send misting reservoir runway events to `index=personal` and keep `reservoir_name` populated so the leaderboard stays actionable.
visualization: Bar chart of misting reservoir runway by reservoirs.
grandmaExplanation: It blends which reservoirss stand out most for misting reservoir runway.
